Binning of the assembled contigs into genomes with MetaBAT 2. Commands for this step were run in `metabat/`.
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
Change directory from flye to metabat for binning 

```{bash}
cd metabat 
```
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
Extract the depth info and store it in depth_bbd.txt

```{bash}
cat ../flye/bbd/assembly_info.txt  | grep -v '#' | awk '{OFS="\t";print $1,$3}' > depths_bbd.txt

```
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
Reorder the contigs based on their and depth and store in assembly_bbd_ordered.fasta

```{bash}
cat depths_bbd.txt | awk '{print $1}' | xargs samtools faidx ../flye/bbd/assembly.fasta > assembly_bbd_ordered.fasta
```
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
Run metabat 

```{bash}
metabat2 -i assembly_bbd_ordered.fasta -a depths_bbd.txt --cvExt -o bins_bbd/metabat --seed 5
```

MetaBAT 2 (nosha) using minContig 2500, minCV 1.0, minCVSum 1.0, maxP 95%, minS 60, maxEdges 200 and minClsSize 200000. with random seed=5
71 bins (39539582 bases in total) formed.
